items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I had excellent training, technical training, from the late George Clisskins, who was Central New York’s — in my estimation — was Central New York’s greatest drum and percussion teacher.

ctx.x: But well I loved her music and it was such a pleasure to play it and I considered myself fortunate to have fallen into this position where I could play with somebody whose music I knew so well and whose music I loved, whose work I loved. And I guess I considered myself pretty fortunate but I think somewhere in the back of my mind I thought I deserved it as well. It was pretty easy to me. I had really good chops.
